cells.gaps: The World Bank's 29.4 per cent for 2024 and the 25.7 per cent cited at the November 2025 national plan round table (GIN-005) disagree across the 27 per cent line; the study reads only the World Bank series. The latest figure, 29.4 per cent of rural people for 2024, is below 53.
cells.note: The World Bank series gives 29.4 per cent of rural people with electricity in 2024, below the 53 per cent line, so stage 2. The national plan's 25.7 per cent, cited in November 2025, is not from the series and does not set the rung.
